architecture.scope: Upstream NuttX Architecture APIs are the public baseline and are not patched in this repository.

chip.scope: BK7258-intrinsic startup, arch APIs, IRQ, serial, timer, heap, raw on-chip controller mechanisms, AP topology/lifecycle, mailbox/IPI/shared memory, RPTUN transport, and SoC-generic lower-half Kconfig/Make definitions. Product image, partition and filesystem composition enter through board Kconfig, linker symbols or typed board-provided descriptors; remaining transitional validation startup is enumerated in the compatibility ledger.

board.scope: Physical board pins, bindings, external peripherals, product image/partition layouts, board Kconfig choices, Flash/MTD/filesystem composition, linker/board configuration, bring-up and device registration.

vendor_common_glue.scope: Existing repository entry and compatibility glue; split each symbol by BK7258 mechanism versus board policy instead of creating a platform layer.
vendor_common_glue.notes: CP/AP sequencing, generation/restart, endpoint/service composition and coordinated-PM orchestration are tagged per item; BK7258-intrinsic mechanisms target chip and board bindings target existing src/ or board bringup.

build_adapter.scope: Host adapters generate Kconfig/.config metadata and invoke existing CMake/Make semantics; they are not a replacement build system.
build_adapter.notes: CMake is the recommended adapter; Classic remains a supported compatibility adapter with legacy semantics.

external_upstream_needed.scope: Generic framework changes belong to upstream NuttX Architecture and are not patched here.
external_upstream_needed.notes: Any future public NuttX/common API requirement must be recorded as external_upstream_needed before coordination.

migration_pending.scope: Production validation auto-start is board policy, not chip mechanism.
migration_pending.notes: Generic JPEG and temperature workers are dispatched explicitly by app/hello_app/bkvalidate_main.c; this migration tag remains pending for the broader validation policy without moving lower halves.

dependency_rules.reason: upstream Architecture is not modified to depend on a vendor chip
upstream Architecture is not modified to depend on a physical board
chip adaptation consumes the upstream Architecture APIs
target rule: chip mechanisms cannot own board pins, external-device policy or product layout; current exceptions must be explicit in the compatibility ledger
board composition consumes public Architecture APIs
board bindings consume BK7258 chip controllers and lower halves

init_phases.name: board_early_initialize
init_phases.notes: Official board early hook owns board-specific pin, bus and external-device preparation.

init_phases.name: board_late_initialize
init_phases.notes: Official late hook remains a thin board entry into the existing compatibility sequence.

init_phases.name: board_app_initialize
init_phases.notes: Official app hook owns board bring-up registration through existing board code.

init_phases.name: board_app_finalinitialize
init_phases.notes: Recorded official phase; any final application policy remains migration metadata only.

build_contract.extension_policy: vendor extensions are additive and not replacement

config_policy.new_seed_requires: genuinely different product mode, lifecycle, boot layout or architecture boundary
